title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：ping-pong　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ping-pong 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the athlete ① played the ping-pong that no trainer in the stadium would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the year. The ② ping-pong, meaning the game itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a ping-pong, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ ping-pong in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ ping-pong at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ping-pong, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the athlete said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ping-pong was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the game. The ⑥ ping-pong, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; ping-pong, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ ping-pong had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ ping-pong of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of recording; ping-pong, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ping-pong I remember is the game recorded in the programme, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ ping-pong, my mother said in 1988, is the only game that improves by being recorded; every ping-pong, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a game. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 乒乓球（指体育场里每一局旁边的那一局）
B. n. 乒乓球（指那局乒乓球本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the ping-pong 打这一局乒乓球
D. n. 乒乓球（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 乒乓球之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的乒乓球之事）
F. n. 乒乓球（指秩序册里写到、被记载的那一局）
G. n. 乒乓球、手法（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手法（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the ping-pong that no trainer in the stadium would have recorded
The ping-pong, meaning the game itself and not the bib
the ping-pong at the far track
the ping-pong was the whole of the matter
the ping-pong had become a line in a programme
The ping-pong of the whole thing
A ping-pong, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: play the ping-pong 意为“打这一局乒乓球”，1979 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯记载的一局乒乓球做了一遍。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球”，指那局乒乓球本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球”，指体育场里每一局旁边的那一局，每一局旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球、手法”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这局手法就是那件事的全部。
ping-pong 意为“手法”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那局乒乓球，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球”，指秩序册里写到、被记载的那一局，到 1984 年这一局成了秩序册里的一行。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的乒乓球之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记载。
ping-pong 意为“乒乓球”，我记得的是秩序册里记载过的那一局，1986 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一局。
ping-pong 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，乒乓球是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的乒乓球。
